candidates.title: GDN Tree-Scan: Served Tree Verification for Recurrent-Hybrid Language Models
candidates.reason: A served tree verifier for recurrent-hybrid LLMs integrated into vLLM, directly extending hardware-aware speculative decoding from attention-only models to recurrent-state-sensitive serving.

candidates.title: Beyond KV Reconstruction: Functional Reconstruction for MLA Draft Models in Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: Targets the interaction between MLA cache compression and draft-target agreement, linking memory-efficient attention conversion directly to speculative decoding performance.

candidates.title: VIA-SD: Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: Introduces multi-tier verification using intra-model routing so rejected draft tokens need not always invoke the full verifier, directly updating speculative-serving compute allocation.

candidates.title: Ygg: Tree-Based Collaborative Speculative Decoding with Token-Only Transmission
candidates.reason: Moves tree speculative decoding into collaborative device-cloud serving with token-only transmission, directly connecting speculative decoding to network and edge-serving constraints.

candidates.title: CoSine: Enhancing LLM Serving via Collaborative and Decoupled Speculative Inference
candidates.reason: Decouples memory-intensive drafting from compute-intensive target verification across serving resources, directly extending disaggregated serving and speculative inference lineages.
